title: Different Paths
content:
For a few moments...

Neither of us spoke.

Shreya continued crying, unable to control herself.

I gently asked,

"What happened, Shreya?"

She tried to answer...

But her voice kept breaking.

"Please..."

"Calm down first."

She took a few deep breaths before slowly stepping back.

After wiping away her tears, she finally looked into my eyes.

"Karthik..."

"He betrayed me."

For a moment...

I couldn't believe what I had heard.

"What?" I asked in disbelief.

She nodded.

"Yes."

"Ruthika and Karthik are actually in a relationship."

"This time... it was true."

A bitter smile appeared on her face.

"Only after everything happened..."

"I finally understood how deeply I had hurt you."

"I'm sorry, Siddu."

"I truly am."

I remained silent for a few seconds.

Then I spoke calmly.

"Karthik deceived you."

"I'm sorry you had to go through that."

"No one deserves to be treated that way."

Shreya lowered her head.

"I don't want to talk about him anymore."

She looked at me with hopeful eyes.

"I have one request."

"Can we... be friends again?"

I smiled gently.

"Thank you..."

"For finally understanding what I went through."

"But..."

"I'm sorry."

"I can't."

She looked at me quietly.

"Whenever I see you..."

"I remember everything."

"The good memories."

"The painful ones."

"And the person I once loved with all my heart."

"If we become friends..."

"I'll never truly move on."

"And neither of us deserves to live in the past forever."

I took a slow breath.

"So..."

"I think this should be our last meeting."

"It was nice seeing you again."

"I sincerely hope you find happiness."

"Take care, Shreya."

"Goodbye."

For a brief moment...

She simply looked at me.

Then she nodded.

Neither of us said another word.

I turned around...

And walked away.

This time...

Without looking back.

The chapter called "Shreya" in my life had finally come to an end.

Later, I told Kiran everything that had happened.

After listening quietly, he simply replied,

"Leave the rest to me."

I nodded.

There was nothing more I wanted from the past.

With a peaceful heart...

I finally left for Uttar Pradesh.

________________________________________

Sneha remained silent for several moments.

Then she smiled.

"You really are a good man, Siddu."

"You've been through so much."

"And yet..."

"You never chose hatred."

"I've learned a lot from your friendship."

"Thank you... for sharing your story with me."

Siddu smiled.

"Between friends..."

"There is no place for 'thank you' or 'sorry.'"

Sneha laughed.

"So that's your rule?"

"It always will be," Siddu replied.

The two of them laughed together as they slowly walked down the hill.

By the time they reached the bottom, evening had begun to settle over Mussoorie.

Their drivers were already waiting.

Sneha looked toward a nearby car.

"My friend Yagnesh is waiting for me."

"From here, I'm heading to Delhi."

She turned back toward Siddu.

"Don't forget to keep in touch."

Siddu smiled warmly.

"I won't."

"Take care of yourself."

"Have a safe journey."

"You too," Sneha replied.

They exchanged one final wave.

Then...

They stepped into different vehicles.

Siddu's cab slowly disappeared along the road leading toward Uttar Pradesh.

Sneha's car turned toward Delhi.

Two friends...

Traveling in opposite directions.

Neither of them knew...

That this goodbye wasn't the end of their journey.

It was the beginning of a new one.
